blocks.html: Once you are enrolled, the main TAK Tracker window shows your position, connection health and movement data at a glance. It works in portrait or landscape.

slides.title: Open the main window
slides.html: After enrollment the main window fills with live data. Every box updates on its own — tap a box to change what it shows or which units it uses.

slides.title: Read your coordinates
slides.html: The location box shows your coordinates. The default format is degrees / minutes / seconds (DMS) — tap the box to switch it to MGRS.

slides.title: Check your connection
slides.html:
The connection box shows three health indicators:

  • Server — shows an error if enrollment failed
  • GPS — shows not available until you enable location services from the Android pull-down drawer
  • Compass — ideally High; Moderate or Unreliable usually means magnetic interference

slides.title: Read altitude, speed, compass and heading
slides.html:
The other four boxes show your movement data. Tap any box to change its units:

  • Altitude — m or ft
  • Speed — m/s, kps, fps or mph
  • Compass and Heading — °MN or °TN
